wardrobe.window.title: Wardrobe
wardrobe.window.empty: No saved outfits yet. Dress up in-game, then click "Save current outfit".
wardrobe.window.help: Save the outfit you're wearing, then switch to it by hotkey (first 8 slots) or with the play button. Row buttons: rename, update to your current outfit, move up, move down, apply, delete. Update and delete ask to confirm. Outfits are saved per character.
